verdict.rationale: Bench is a bookkeeping service, so a documented ledger-export API is a fair question to ask of it. The evidence shows no developer API, and the OpenAPI probes all returned 404. The only export evidence is downloading income statements and balance sheets from the app, which is adjacent: it is neither a general ledger nor a trial balance, and it is not delivered through an API.

support.subject: As a developer, I can pull the full general ledger and trial balance through a documented API in open formats
